_mode_note: Three execution modes. 'paper' is the in-process simulator that has run Phase A since April and contacts no venue. 'broker_paper' runs the REAL order lifecycle against Alpaca's paper endpoint -- this is what the registered October validation month runs. 'live' is the same path against the live endpoint from Nov 1. The endpoint and credential pair are derived from this value IN CODE and are never read from ALPACA_BASE_URL; see src/execution/broker.py.

starting_capital._note: Per-book starting capital, by execution mode. Read ONLY through config_loader.starting_capital(), which raises PendingCapitalError for any mode listed in _pending_confirmation. broker_paper and live were CONFIRMED by the hub on 2026-09-11 at 2000 USD per book (BOOK_CAPITAL_PHASE_B) and _pending_confirmation is now empty. The two live-path modes carry the same figure deliberately: October validates the live configuration in the venue's broker-paper mode, so a broker-paper book that sized differently from its November self would not be validating the configuration that runs.

capital_structure._note: Phase B registered capital structure (hub ruling 2026-09-11). The registered capital BASE is live_cohort_book_count x starting_capital[mode] -- five books x $2,000 = $10,000 -- and it is the only denominator any return may be computed on. Read through config_loader.registered_capital_base(); do not re-derive it at a call site.
capital_structure._reserve_master_note: ADDITIONAL to the registered base, not carved out of it. It sits at master level for fees and settlement rounding, bringing total committed exposure to $10,500. It is OUTSIDE the registered capital base and NEVER enters a return denominator -- a return computed on $10,500 would be wrong. config_loader.reserve_master() is deliberately the only reader, and registered_capital_base() deliberately does not call it.
capital_structure._live_cohort_keys_note: RULED by the hub 2026-09-14. DeepSeek is excluded per the exploratory-only determination; the other five books fund. This resolves the UNRESOLVED state this key carried from 2026-09-14 (count registered, composition not) -- config_loader.live_cohort_keys() no longer raises PendingCohortError. NOT a derived value: it is not the core cohort (that would keep deepseek and drop claude_opus, the expansion book), which is exactly why deriving it was refused. SUBJECT TO RATIFICATION at the Rossi methodology review 2026-09-17; a reversal is a one-line amendment to this array plus live_cohort_book_count, and nothing else moves -- the registered capital base is computed from the count, so it follows automatically. See operational_events.2026-09.live_cohort_composition_ruled.

execution._note: Live order-lifecycle parameters. fill_deadline_seconds is the registered fill-time cap (2026-08-29 ruling): an order still unfilled at the deadline has its remainder cancelled and its partial fill stands, logged as an UNFILLED_AT_DEADLINE execution-constraint event, which is execution-SUCCESSFUL and separately a disclosed per-model descriptor. Frozen with the configuration on Oct 1; tunable only before then.

settlement._note: Settled-funds execution constraint (cash-account branch), registered 2026-08-17. BOTH conditions must hold for enforcement to bind: enforce_settled_funds true AND run date >= activation_date. The flag flips at the signed-off 2026-09-16 pre-market activation, and only if the September 15 branch decision selects the cash branch -- same discipline as the 2026-07-01 shorting flip. Until then every settled-funds code path is inert and settled_cash == cash.

tick_spacing._note: Minimum minutes between cohort decision ticks. Implements the registered ~30-minute cadence; it is not a change to it. Measured against the last COMPLETED decision in the committed logs, so a backup run filling a genuine gap still runs. `enabled: false` reverts to pre-guard behaviour without a code change.

claude._pin_status: UNPINNED: Anthropic echoes the alias unchanged; current dated snapshot id unconfirmed. Resolve manually before pinning (a wrong id silently changes the running model).

gemini._pin_status: UNPINNED: Google echoes the alias unchanged. The adapter now captures response.model_version, so the real dated id will surface in model_id_returned on the next live run; pin from that.

deepseek._pin_note: Deliberately repointed deepseek-v4-flash -> deepseek-v4-pro on 2026-05-21: the deepseek-reasoner alias deprecates 2026-07-24 and maps to sub-frontier v4-flash; v4-pro is DeepSeek's current frontier reasoning tier, restoring cohort parity. No dated immutable snapshot exists beneath deepseek-v4-pro, so this is the most specific callable id (same standard as the dateless Claude ids); residual drift risk if DeepSeek repoints it. Runs in thinking mode at reasoning_effort=high (see deepseek_adapter.py).
